tweet.text:
what local businesses don't want:

- ai agents to chat with (creates work for them)
- skills for claude/gpt, etc.
- a knowledge graph / brain
- learning how to code & build internal tools
- automation with unclear business outcomes

what they do want:

- more calls, more customers, less headaches

keep the sauce as part of your internal process, sell outcomes and clarity. the fact that you use AI is a given

that is translated to the customer in terms of the value you create, the time you save them, and the price at which you deliver the outcomes
